title: Explore the prototype
description: A short walkthrough captured from the generated Vue and Nuxt UI starter. The sample data stays in this browser tab.

steps.title: Start with the sample
steps.text: The starter labels its sample data and presents three ideas. Saving only changes this tab; reloading restores the sample.

steps.title: Find an idea
steps.text: Enter “interaction” in Find an idea to narrow the list to one matching result.

steps.title: Save the matching idea
steps.text: Choose Save. The button changes to Saved and exposes its pressed state to assistive technology.
